policies.title: Double-Blind Peer Review Policy
policies.statement: All original research, short communications, and systematic reviews undergo rigorous double-blind evaluation by at least two independent subject specialists.
compliance: Author names, institutions, and acknowledgements are stripped prior to reviewer dispatch.
Reviewers must declare absence of personal, academic, or financial competing interests.
Editorial decisions are based exclusively on academic merit, validity, and methodological soundness.

policies.title: Authorship Criteria & AI Transparency
policies.statement: Authorship credit must follow ICMJE guidelines. AI and LLM tools cannot be listed as authors and must be transparently disclosed.
compliance: Every listed author must have made substantial contributions to design, data acquisition, or analysis.
Any generative AI usage in data generation, analysis, or drafting must be explicitly stated in the Methods.
Corresponding author takes institutional responsibility for all communication and data integrity.

policies.title: Plagiarism & Similarity Screening
policies.statement: Every submission is screened via Crossref Similarity Check (iThenticate) before assignment to handling editors.
compliance: Overall similarity index must strictly remain below 15%, with no single source exceeding 3%.
Self-plagiarism and redundant publication of previously copyrighted material are strictly prohibited.
Manuscripts showing unreferenced text matching will be rejected immediately at desk screening.

policies.title: Human & Animal Research Approvals
policies.statement: Studies involving human subjects, patient records, or animal models must demonstrate formal institutional ethical clearance.
compliance: Human studies must comply with the Declaration of Helsinki and include IRB/Ethics Committee approval numbers.
Informed written consent must be documented for all patient-derived clinical data and photographs.
Animal experiments must adhere to ARRIVE guidelines and national veterinary welfare standards.

policies.title: Open Access & Creative Commons CC BY 4.0
policies.statement: Published scholarship is distributed freely and immediately worldwide under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
compliance: Authors retain unrestricted copyright and intellectual property rights in their work.
Readers are permitted to share, copy, distribute, and adapt the material with appropriate academic attribution.
Permanent DOIs are registered via CrossRef with automatic preservation in institutional repositories.

policies.title: Confidentiality & Conflict Recusal
policies.statement: Manuscript files, data, reviewer reports, and editorial deliberations are strictly confidential academic assets.
compliance: Editors and reviewers are barred from citing, using, or discussing unpublished manuscript contents.
Board members submitting manuscripts are completely blind to the handling editor and reviewer assignments.
Editors immediately recuse themselves from handling submissions from their own department or collaborators.

editorial-safeguards.label: Editorial Safeguards
editorial-safeguards.description: Heading, intro and the five enforcement checkpoints
editorial-safeguards.title: How Policy is Enforced on Every Manuscript
editorial-safeguards.subtitle: EDITORIAL SAFEGUARDS
editorial-safeguards.content: Five sequential checkpoints ensure every published paper meets verified standards of ethics, reproducibility, and originality.

steps.title: Initial Desk Intake & Scope Screening
steps.description: Editorial secretariat verifies submission completeness, author declarations, ethics documentation, and journal scope alignment.

steps.title: Automated Plagiarism & Similarity Check
steps.description: Crossref Similarity Check verifies originality against billions of published articles and web repositories prior to editor review.

steps.title: Double-Blind Referee Assignment
steps.description: Section Editor appoints independent, non-conflicted reviewers who appraise the anonymized manuscript across 5 criteria.

steps.title: Merit-Based Editorial Decision
steps.description: Editor-in-Chief synthesizes independent referee reports to issue an objective determination: Accept, Revise, or Reject.

steps.title: Permanent Open Access & CrossMark Indexing
steps.description: Final articles receive permanent CrossRef DOIs, CrossMark metadata integrity tracking, and open CC BY 4.0 deposition.

record-integrity.label: Record Integrity
record-integrity.description: Corrections, expressions of concern and retractions cards
record-integrity.title: Post-Publication Amendments & Retractions
record-integrity.subtitle: RECORD INTEGRITY
record-integrity.content: When published evidence requires clarification or withdrawal, transparent notices preserve the historical accuracy of the scholarly record.

actions.title: Corrigenda & Addenda (Corrections)
actions.description: Material errors of fact, calculation, or mislabeled figures that do not undermine the central scientific conclusions are corrected via a linked formal Corrigendum notice permanently tied to the DOI.

actions.title: Expressions of Concern
actions.description: When serious concerns regarding research integrity, data fabrication, or authorship disputes arise and an investigation is pending, an official Expression of Concern is appended to alert the academic community.

actions.title: Formal Article Retractions
actions.description: If findings are proven unreliable due to misconduct or honest error, the article is formally retracted in accordance with COPE Retraction Guidelines. The PDF remains in the archive with a prominent retraction watermark.
